description.value: The Chopped Leaf is a proudly Canadian fast-casual chain founded in 2009, now spanning 124+ locations, built around customizable salads, wraps, bowls, soups, and sandwiches made with fresh greens. This Surrey franchise occupies Unit 102 at a ground-level commercial strip on Croydon Drive, with online ordering and catering available. It aims to reframe healthy greens as comfort food, offering a filling and practical meal option for cyclists moving through the area.
